alpha_hypothesis.playbook_alignment: Continues state-surface maturation with a rank-depth quality field, avoids LLM soft-ranking data limits, and avoids broad noisy candidate-pool expansion.

backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md canonical three fixed windows; core unchanged plus default-off state-surface paper overlay replay.

gate1.baseline_note: Uses the accepted rank3 near-high support stack as Gate 1 baseline.

gate3.hard_rule: No filter or candidate gate changed; only queue_rank == 2 paper notional changes.

history_check.anti_repeat: Not a score-gap, ret20, ret60, sector-cohesion, repeat-lookback, candidate-pool, or LLM soft-ranking retry.
history_check.exp-20260519-004: Accepted rank-3 near-high support; this experiment freezes it and tests rank-2 own near-high confirmation, not rank3 threshold/scalar retuning.
history_check.exp-20260519-005: Rejected front-rank near-high support because mid_weak EV regressed and drawdown drift exceeded guardrail; this experiment removes queue_rank 1 exposure from the causal variable.

hypothesis: Rank-2 rotation state-surface candidates near their own 60-day highs represent resilient continuation alternatives and deserve bounded default-off paper-notional support.
interpretation: Rank-2 near-high support improved the default-off state-surface paper overlay in all three windows while staying paper-only and production-visible.

llm_metrics.why_not_llm: LLM soft-ranking data remains sparse/PIT-limited; this deterministic rank-depth field is replayable from OHLCV-derived near-high metadata.

next_evidence_needed: Promote only as shared default-off paper metadata; keep forward tail/concentration monitoring before any live adapter work.

locked_variables: front-rank near-high support rejected in exp-20260519-005
parameters.profile_priority: applies after accepted rank-notional and rank3 support profiles, before pending paper entry; applies only to queue_rank == 2

protocol_answers.1_alpha_hypothesis: capital allocation: queue_rank == 2 candidates close to 60-day highs indicate resilient continuation quality and deserve bounded paper-notional support.
protocol_answers.2_history_check: Prior accepted work covered rank1 isolation and rank3 queue-depth support; exp-20260519-005 rejected broad rank1/2 near-high support, so this isolates rank2 only.
protocol_answers.4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; positive aggregate EV/PnL, all three windows EV-positive, zero EV-regressed windows, adjusted trades >=5 across all 3 windows, max DD drift <=0.5pp, single-ticker positive share <=50%.
